summary: Taylor Morrison Home Corp filed an 8-K reporting its entry into a definitive merger agreement with Berkshire Hathaway Inc. Under the agreement, a wholly owned Berkshire subsidiary will merge with Taylor Morrison, with Taylor Morrison surviving as a wholly owned Berkshire subsidiary. Shareholders will receive $72.50 per share in cash. The board unanimously approved and recommends adoption. The transaction includes treatment of equity awards, with RSUs partially deferred. The merger represents a take-private by Berkshire, a large strategic acquirer. Watch for regulatory approvals and shareholder vote; the all-cash, single-buyer structure simplifies the arb but closing timeline remains key.
